purpose: Frozen input contract for the deterministic point-in-time (PIT) evidence packet that populates each Item 6 Stage-1 fixture request. Closes the empty-skeleton defect: the frozen mechanism prompt tells the model it receives a pre-target evidence packet and requires evidence_refs + observables drawn from that packet; this contract defines exactly what that packet contains and how it is built, deterministically and PIT-safely, with zero paid inference and zero future information.

provider_policy.cross_provider_merge_forbidden_reason: The Item 6 cohort is keyed on FootyStats numeric ids; FootyStats and TheStatsAPI share no join key in this project and identically-named provider fields (e.g. xg, total_shots) are treated as NON-equivalent (capability.DO_NOT_MERGE). The packet therefore uses ONE provider (FootyStats) end to end.

excluded_metrics.reason: TheStatsAPI-only np_expected_goals; excluded upstream (baseline_coverage: 'np_xg excluded upstream, stays excluded'); structurally absent from FootyStats corpus. Never surfaced.
Not in item6 provider_vocab.PROVIDER_METRICS; FootyStats/TheStatsAPI xg are non-equivalent (DO_NOT_MERGE, corr 0.55). Never surfaced as an observable.

information_cutoff_semantics.strict_rule: Every underlying observation contributing to the packet MUST have occurred STRICTLY BEFORE the target kickoff (prior_match.date_unix < target.kickoff_unix). Same-kickoff and later matches are excluded.
forbidden_inputs: the target match's own statistics or result
any fixture with kickoff_unix >= target kickoff
future or announced lineups / injuries / suspensions for the target
closing lines, opening lines, or any market/odds data

allowed_metric_vocabulary.note: Canonical metric ids are exactly the subset of item6 provider_vocab.PROVIDER_METRICS that has a genuine FootyStats source. TheStatsAPI-only vocab metrics (big_chances, accurate_crosses, touches_in_penalty_area, ball_recoveries, tackles, interceptions, blocks, clearances, passes, pass_accuracy) are ABSENT from FootyStats and are OMITTED (never fabricated). Formation/lineup is OMITTED (not populated in the discovery corpus, 0/5000 sampled).
allowed_metric_vocabulary.perspective_policy: Each match-resolution metric is exposed for BOTH perspectives where meaningful: FOR (the team's own production) and AGAINST (what the team's opponents produced against it). goals is also exposed as goals AGAINST (== goals_conceded). This lets the model reason about attack vs concession across DIFFERENT metrics (cross-metric asymmetry), not just same-metric mirrors.

period_policy: FIRST_HALF / SECOND_HALF aggregates are emitted ONLY for metrics with genuine FootyStats half fields (corner_kicks via fh/2h_corners, goals via ht/2h goals, cards_2h via 2h_cards). All other metrics are FULL_MATCH only. No half aggregate is fabricated for a match-only metric.
venue_scope_policy: ALL is always computed. HOME/AWAY splits are computed from the team's recorded historical venue in each prior match (record.homeID/awayID). The target fixture's own venue (home team vs away team) is exposed only as neutralized fixture identity, never as an outcome.
window_policy: ALL_PRIOR = every strictly-prior completed match of the team (unbounded lookback within corpus). RECENT_5 = the 5 most recent strictly-prior completed matches. Windows W10 etc. are intentionally not emitted to bound packet size; ALL_PRIOR + RECENT_5 suffice to expose recent-vs-long-run context that the baseline already covers univariately and that the model may combine cross-metrically.

evidence_item_schema.encoding_description: Evidence is emitted as a JSON object `evidence` mapping each unique evidence_ref (string key) to a compact tuple [value, sample_n, reliability_code]. Field names are hoisted to the packet-level `legend`; the evidence_ref itself encodes team_role/metric/perspective/period/venue_scope/window. This is an information-preserving representation (no value, sample_n, reliability, or ref is dropped) chosen to keep the full Converse request within the 32768-byte ceiling. A parallel `evidence_order` array lists refs in the frozen value-neutral order.

field_semantics.evidence_ref: Stable unique deterministic id. Format E:<team_role>:<metric>:<perspective>:<period>:<venue_scope>:<window>. Resolves to exactly one evidence tuple. Deterministically decodable via resolve_evidence_ref.
field_semantics.team_role: TEAM_A (target home team) | TEAM_B (target away team) | COMPETITION_CONTEXT
field_semantics.perspective: FOR | AGAINST | NEUTRAL (NEUTRAL only for competition-environment reference means)
field_semantics.value: deterministic mean of the metric over the window's strictly-prior matches (float, 3 decimals). Descriptive historical average only; never a probability/effect/odds.
field_semantics.sample_n: integer count of strictly-prior matches with a populated observation contributing to value
field_semantics.reliability_code: 0/1/2 categorical support label derived ONLY from sample_n; no numeric reliability score, no shrinkage weight exposed

scope_grid_policy.description: Per (metric, period, perspective), a frozen value-independent (venue_scope, window) grid is emitted (chosen structurally, never from any outcome): FULL_MATCH+FOR => {ALLxALL_PRIOR, HOMExALL_PRIOR, AWAYxALL_PRIOR, ALLxRECENT_5}; FULL_MATCH+AGAINST => {ALLxALL_PRIOR, ALLxRECENT_5}; FIRST_HALF/SECOND_HALF (incl. cards_2h) => {ALLxALL_PRIOR} for both FOR and AGAINST. This preserves both-team, attack+defense, venue, recency, and half/state coverage across all metric families while bounding packet bytes.

reliability_policy.rationale: The model must see whether a visible average rests on 2 vs 30 observations, but Item 6 does not ask the model to compute feasibility, so no numeric reliability/shrinkage weight is exposed (that stays with the deterministic engine).

provenance_requirements.per_observation_match_ids_enumerated_rea: Enumerating every source match id per statistic would explode packet bytes; instead each team's packet binds its total n_source_matches and the min/max source kickoff window, and the whole packet is content-hashed. Full per-observation provenance is deterministically reproducible from the frozen corpus + materializer + cutoff.

ordering_policy.description: Evidence items are ordered by a frozen value-independent key: (team_role order [TEAM_A, TEAM_B, COMPETITION_CONTEXT], then canonical metric id ascending alphabetical from a frozen metric registry, then perspective [FOR, AGAINST, NEUTRAL], then period [FULL_MATCH, FIRST_HALF, SECOND_HALF], then venue_scope [ALL, HOME, AWAY], then window [ALL_PRIOR, RECENT_5]). Ordering NEVER depends on the value, sample_n, variance, or any salience/importance. No metric family (e.g. corners or shots) is privileged by position; alphabetical-by-canonical-id is deliberately value-neutral.
ordering_policy.metric_registry_order_note: Frozen ascending alphabetical by canonical metric id (matches packet_materializer.METRIC_REGISTRY exactly: cards_2h < corner_kicks < ...). This is the ONLY ordering authority; the mechanism prompt's mention order does not influence packet order.

missing_value_policy.description: A metric observation that is NULL or the FootyStats sentinel -1 is treated as MISSING and excluded from the aggregate (NULL != ZERO). If a (metric, perspective, period, venue_scope, window) cell has zero populated prior observations, that evidence item is OMITTED entirely (it is never emitted with a fabricated 0 value and never listed in the observable vocabulary for that team if the team has no populated observations of the metric in any scope).

observable_vocabulary_exposure.rule: The packet exposes, per fixture, an observable_vocabulary list = the sorted set of canonical metrics for which at least one non-empty evidence item was emitted (i.e. actually measurable for this fixture's teams from pre-target FootyStats data). A metric is listed IFF it is genuinely present; the schema knowing a metric name is NOT sufficient.

max_packet_size.note: The full canonical Converse request (system prompt + fixture identity + this packet + tool schema + inferenceConfig) MUST be <= 32768 UTF-8 bytes, enforced by request_builder.within_byte_budget. The materializer emits a bounded number of evidence items (see cap) and rounds values to 3 decimals to keep bytes bounded. If any full request exceeds the ceiling, a frozen compression policy is applied (see compression_policy).

compression_policy.required_in_this_freeze_reason: With the frozen COMPACT_MAP encoding and compact scope grid, all 120 fully-materialized Converse requests are <= 32768 bytes (observed max ~28.2 KB). No compression is applied.
compression_policy.note: A frozen information-preserving compression policy exists as a separate contingency artifact and would be applied ONLY if a fully-materialized request exceeded the byte ceiling. It never uses future outcomes and never systematically privileges one metric family.

evidence_ref_format.uniqueness: Each evidence_ref binds to exactly one evidence item. Duplicate refs are a materialization failure (fail closed).
evidence_ref_format.stability: Deterministic and stable under replay from the frozen corpus + cutoff.

determinism_requirements.canonical_json: sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; values rounded to 3 decimals before hashing
determinism_requirements.packet_hash: sha256 over canonical JSON of the packet body (excluding the packet's own self-hash field)
